subject: ProofPoint trial: ingest profile, success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@proofpoint.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: ProofPoint trial: ingest profile, success criteria & next steps

Hi Linda — great call this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we kick off the trial: 

Summary / success criteria
- Primary goal: verify 95th pct latency <= 350ms for single-turn search/completion flows at expected burst traffic and keep token-cost within target budget.
- Secondary: embedding recall for similarity search >= 0.82 on our benchmark set, and no data leakage (logs retained per your retention policy).

Workload intake (we need concrete values here to size Dedicated vs hosted config):
- Typical RPS: ? (please confirm average and peak over a 24h window)
- Average prompt length (tokens): ? (avg and 95th pct)
- Average completion length (tokens): ?
- Concurrency targets: e.g. 50 sustained, 250 burst for 30s — please confirm
- Burst patterns: predictable (batch jobs) or spiky (user-driven)? any timezone/region concentration?

Ask: please send a short sample of your traffic profile (CSV or a short syslog extract) and any SLO/latency expectations by next Tue, May 4. I attached a mutual action plan and an evaluation template to make this faster.

Proposed timeline / owners
- 4/28–5/4: exchange workload samples + finalize success criteria (ProofPoint: Linda / engops)
- 5/5–5/11: Redwood staging run (ingest sample traffic, baseline latency/cost) (Redwood: Markus / Karthik)
- 5/12–5/19: Trial window with instrumented telemetry and checkpoints (both)
- 5/20: Readout and next steps (exec alignment)

Immediate next steps
1) Linda: share ingest-sample-logs.csv + confirmation of average/peak RPS and token sizes
2) ProofPoint engops: confirm maintenance windows or IP allowlisting needs
3) Karthik/Jordan: I’ll loop you in on infra needs and support rota once we receive logs.

Attaching: ProofPoint-POC-MAP.docx, poc-eval-template.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

—
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0123

From: Linda Park <linda.park@proofpoint.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: engops@proofpoint.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ProofPoint trial: ingest profile, success criteria & next steps

Thanks Markus — really helpful recap. Attached a small extract of our proxy logs (ingest-sample-logs.csv) and a short note from EngOps. Quick answers inline: 

- Typical RPS: 18 avg during business hours (08:00–18:00 PT), sustained baseline ~6 RPS overnight. Peak observed: 220 RPS for ~25–35s during product release windows.
- Prompt tokens (user prompt): median 34 tokens, 95th pct 210 tokens.
- Completion tokens (model reply): median 48, 95th pct 420.
- Concurrency target: we’d like to validate up to 180 concurrent requests in the trial; typical concurrency is 12–30.
- Burst patterns: mainly user-driven spikes tied to major UI actions; concentrated in US-West.

EngOps note: we’ll need an allowlist for 3 Redwood egress IPs (I listed them in the attached note) and we prefer a staged run into our non-prod environment first.

Attaching: ingest-sample-logs.csv

Onwards: I can commit to the timeline you proposed. We’ll aim to deliver any follow-up telemetry and a short baseline dataset by Friday, 4/30.

Best,
Linda
Linda Park
Head of AI Ops, ProofPoint Systems
linda.park@proofpoint.com

On Wed, Apr 28, 2027 at 10:15 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Linda — great call this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we kick off the trial: ...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ProofPoint trial: ingest profile, success criteria & next steps

Short note — thanks Linda for the detail. Markus, a couple quick asks from infra planning side: 
- Based on Linda’s numbers we should plan for a 256GB KV cache footprint and a mixed-precision quantized model on Dedicated for cost control. Can you confirm the model family they prefer (open Llama variant vs. L2 adapted)?
- I’ll spin up a staging cluster for 5/5 and add Jordan to the on-call list for runbook handoffs.

Jordan — can you prepare an initial runbook placeholder (who to call, escalation path, measurement dashboard) by Friday? I’ll assign infra tickets once Markus confirms model pick.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Linda Park <linda.park@proofpoint.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ProofPoint trial: ingest profile, success criteria & next steps

Thanks everyone — short confirmation and owners: 
- Model selection: start with an open LLaMA-2 13B quantized baseline; we’ll try a 70B variant if latency headroom allows (Owner: Markus).
- Infra: Karthik to provision staging cluster (5/5) and handle quantization profile; Jordan to own runbook and on-call rotation.
- ProofPoint: Linda/EngOps to provide allowlist and final logs by 4/30 EOD (thanks for committing).

Deliverables & timeline reminder:
- 5/4: Redwood to confirm final staging footprint after reviewing logs (Markus/Karthik)
- 5/5–5/11: staging runs with sample traffic (Redwood)
- 5/12–5/19: trial window (both)
- 5/20: readout

Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0A1ProofPoint-POC (will drop runbook + trial dashboard here once provisioned)

Markus
